name: grr-al
summary: This EA monitors each new bar's opening price and trades on a breakout of DELTA points from that level within the same bar. It enters a buy when price moves above the bar open by DELTA points, or a sell when it moves below by DELTA points, with fixed SL/TP and no position management. The strategy is a simple intrabar breakout system with no trailing stops or multi-position logic.
summary_zh: 该EA监控每根新K线的开盘价，当价格在同一K线内突破开盘价上下DELTA点数时入场交易。买入条件为价格高于开盘价DELTA点，卖出条件为价格低于开盘价DELTA点，采用固定止损止盈且无持仓管理。这是一个简单的K线内突破策略，没有移动止损或多仓位逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于K线内突破的日内交易策略，利用新K线开盘价作为参考基准线，等待价格在K线周期内突破该基准线一定点数后顺势入场。入场条件为：在新K线形成后，若当前买价高于开盘价DELTA点则卖出（反向突破），若当前买价低于开盘价DELTA点则买入——注意这里的逻辑似乎是反向的，卖出在价格上涨时触发而买入在价格下跌时触发，存在逻辑错误嫌疑。出场条件为固定止损100点和止盈700点，风险回报比为1:7。仓位管理方面，当RISK为0时使用固定手数BASELOT=0.1，否则根据账户可用保证金的90%乘以RISK比例计算手数。资金管理存在冗余代码（RISK==0判断重复），且没有检查已有持仓数量，可能造成过度开仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is an intrabar breakout trading system that uses the new bar's opening price as a reference level, entering when price breaks away from that level by a defined DELTA within the same bar. Entry conditions: after a new bar forms, if the current bid price exceeds the bar open by DELTA points, a SELL order is placed; if the bid falls below the bar open by DELTA points, a BUY order is placed — notably the logic appears inverted, selling on upward breakouts and buying on downward breakouts, which suggests a possible logic error. Exit conditions use fixed stop loss of 100 points and take profit of 700 points, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:7. Position sizing uses a fixed BASELOT of 0.1 when RISK is 0, otherwise calculates lot size based on 90% of free margin multiplied by the RISK factor, capped at the broker's maximum lot. Money management has redundant code (duplicate RISK==0 check) and lacks any check for existing open positions, which could lead to over-trading on strong trending moves.

parameters.name: MAGIC_NUMBER
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: RISK
parameters.description: 风险系数，0表示使用固定手数，非0则按保证金比例计算手数
parameters.description_en: Risk coefficient; 0=fixed lots, non-zero=margin percentage lot sizing

parameters.name: DELTA
parameters.description: 突破触发距离（点），价格超过开盘价此距离时入场
parameters.description_en: Breakout trigger distance in points from open price

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和修改
止盈远大于止损（1:7风险回报比），单笔盈利可以覆盖多笔亏损
使用魔术编号区分订单，避免与其他EA冲突
有OrderCheck预检查机制，避免无效订单提交
每根K线只触发一次突破信号（br标志位控制），防止重复入场
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and modify
Take profit is much larger than stop loss (1:7 risk-reward ratio), where a single win can cover multiple losses
Uses magic number to identify orders, preventing conflicts with other EAs
Has OrderCheck pre-validation to avoid sending invalid orders
Each bar only triggers one breakout signal (br flag control), preventing repeated entries within the same bar
cons: 入场逻辑疑似反向：价格上涨触发卖出、价格下跌触发买入，与突破策略常规逻辑不符
没有任何持仓检查，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓导致过度暴露
止损止盈使用固定点数而非考虑ATR或市场波动性，在不同品种上效果差异大
RISK==0判断重复出现两次，存在冗余代码
使用ORDER_FILLING_FOK可能在不流动市场导致订单全部被拒
没有考虑点差、隔夜费用等交易成本对策略的影响
cons_en: Entry logic appears inverted: sell triggered on price rise and buy triggered on price decline, contradicting typical breakout strategy convention
No position check exists, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction leading to overexposure
Stop loss and take profit use fixed point values without considering ATR or market volatility, causing inconsistent performance across different instruments
Duplicate RISK==0 check indicates redundant code
Using ORDER_FILLING_FOK may cause full order rejection in illiquid markets
Does not account for spread, swap, or other trading costs that impact strategy profitability
improvements: 修正入场逻辑方向：上涨突破应买入而非卖出，下跌突破应卖出而非买入，或者明确标注这是反转策略
增加持仓数量检查，限制同方向持仓数量或总持仓数量，避免过度开仓风险
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算方式，使策略能自适应不同品种和市场的波动性
improvements_en: Fix the entry logic direction: upward breakout should trigger buy not sell, downward breakout should trigger sell not buy, or explicitly document this as a reversal strategy
Add position count checks to limit same-direction or total open positions, preventing overexposure risk
Change stop loss and take profit to ATR-based dynamic calculation so the strategy adapts to different instruments and market volatility conditions

risk_points: 没有持仓检查，可能在单边行情中不断开仓导致严重过度暴露
入场方向疑似反转，可能导致与预期相反的持仓方向造成重大亏损
固定止损100点在某些高波动品种上可能过小容易被扫损
使用90%可用保证金计算仓位，在RISK非零时可能导致过度杠杆
risk_points_en: No position check, potentially opening excessive positions during strong trends leading to severe overexposure
Entry direction appears inverted, potentially causing positions in the opposite of intended direction and major losses
Fixed 100-point stop loss may be too tight for high-volatility instruments and easily triggered by noise
Using 90% of free margin for lot calculation when RISK is non-zero can lead to excessive leverage
